17850839427633812.ingredients:
50 g cooked quinoa
50 g steamed edamame
Grated cheese or crumbled paneer
A little ghee or oil
17850839427633812.method:
Mash quinoa + steamed edamame together.
Add grated cheese or crumbled paneer and mix well.
Shape into small bites.
Cook on a pan with a little ghee or oil until golden and cooked well on both sides.
Cool slightly & serve as easy finger food

17915885943452394.ingredients:
Wet ingredients:
1 small ripe banana
1/2 cup pumpkin puree
1 cup milk of choice
2 Tbsp avocado oil
1 tsp vanilla extract
Dry ingredients:
1 1/2 cups oat flour (or can blend rolled oats to flour consistency)
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/2 tsp pumpkin pie spice
17915885943452394.method: Whisk together wet ingredients in a mixing bowl first, then fold in dry ingredients. Cook in a waffle iron until golden. (Makes perfect mini waffles!)

17950832658054931.ingredients:
65 g rolled oats
140 g cooked beetroot
120 g plain full-fat Greek yogurt
1 tsp cinnamon
½ tsp baking powder
A little water, if needed
17950832658054931.method:
Add all ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth.
The batter should be thick enough to hold its shape on the pan, not runny.
If it’s too thick, add a little water and blend again. If it’s too thin, add 1–2 tbsp of oat flour or ground oats. You can also add 1 tbsp of ground flaxseed to help bind the mixture.
Heat a lightly oiled nonstick pan over low-medium heat.
Spoon small portions onto the pan and cook covered for approximately 2–3 minutes per side, or until fully cooked through.
Let cool slightly and serve in age-appropriate pieces.

17968876950176305.ingredients:
½ cup white rice
1 cup water
1 cup whole milk + more if needed
½ tsp cinnamon
⅓ cup pumpkin purée
1–2 tbsp maple syrup
½ tsp vanilla
Pinch of nutmeg, optional
17968876950176305.method:
Lightly rinse the rice and add it to a pot with the water. Cover and simmer for about 10–12 minutes, until most of the water is absorbed.
Add the milk and cinnamon and cook uncovered on low for another 10–15 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is nice and soft and creamy.
Stir in the pumpkin, vanilla and maple syrup and cook for another 3–5 minutes. Turn off the heat. Add a little more milk if you want it creamier it thicken as it cools!

17983657595548165.ingredients:
Butter
Garlic
Turmeric powder
Garam masala
Lentils
Rice
Spinach
Handful of cheese or scoop of Greek yogurt
17983657595548165.method: Butter, garlic, turmeric powder, garam masala with lentils and rice! Toss in spinach, handful of cheese or scoop of Greek yogurt!

18016571609668926.ingredients:
Oil
Mustard seeds
Cumin seeds
Hing
Diced onions
Grated broccoli
Grated ginger
Basmati rice
Whole milk Greek yogurt
Salt
Chopped spinach
18016571609668926.method: Be sure to chop the onions finely and cook them until super soft! I sometimes add peas, corn, grated carrots or grated garlic.

18036244055672580.ingredients:
1 cup kala chana (black chickpeas), steamed and mashed
1 medium sweet potato, peeled, steamed, and mashed
1 tbsp walnuts and cashews
1/4 cup chickpea flour (besan)
2 tbsp rice flour (for crispiness)
1 tbsp flaxseeds or flaxseeds powder
1 tsp cumin powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1 to 2 tsp garam masala
1/2 tsp turmeric
1/2 tsp red chili powder (optional)
1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
Salt to taste
1 tbsp oil for mixing
Oil or ghee for cooking
18036244055672580.method:
I store Kala Chana in the freezer , hence I began by steaming them and sweet potato along with walnuts and cashews together until soft (about 10-15 minutes), then mash them well.
Next, combine the mashed mixture with chickpea flour, rice flour, flaxseeds or powder, and all the spices.
Add oil and mix everything to form a soft dough. If it’s too dry, add a little water as needed.
Shape the dough into small tikkis (patties).
Cook the tikkis on medium heat until golden and crispy on both sides.
Serve hot with green chutney, yogurt or ketchup!

18038573057660275.ingredients:
Wheat noodles
Firm tofu
Peanut butter
Cucumber, optional
Water or milk
18038573057660275.method:
Boil water and cook the wheat noodles.
While the noodles are cooking, blend firm tofu + peanut butter + a little water until smooth and creamy.
Finely chop the cucumber for topping.
Once the noodles are cooked, rinse them under cold water to cool them down.
Add the creamy soybean soup, top with cucumber and serve!

18052510769808237.ingredients:
300–320 g / 10.6–11.3 oz chicken breast, finely chopped
1 small onion, finely diced
1 spring onion, chopped
3 tbsp cornstarch
50–60 ml / 3–4 tbsp water
½ tsp salt
½ tsp garlic powder (or 1–2 minced garlic cloves)
Black pepper
Oil, for frying
For the spicy dipping sauce:
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame oil
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 garlic clove, minced
1 tsp chili flakes
1 tsp crispy chili oil
Fresh coriander, chopped
18052510769808237.method:
Finely chop the chicken breast with a knife. Add to a bowl with onion, spring onion, cornstarch, water and seasonings. Mix until well combined and slightly creamy.
Heat a little oil in a 24 cm / 9.5-inch non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add half the chicken mixture and spread into a thin, even pancake. Cook until golden and crispy underneath.
Carefully flip and cook the other side until beautifully golden and the chicken is fully cooked. Repeat with the remaining mixture.
Mix all the dipping sauce ingredients in a small bowl.
Slice the crispy pancakes, dip into that spicy sauce and enjoy!

18084222794702170.ingredients:
1 cup mashed purple sweet potato (explained below) I get mine from Whole Foods, if not available just use regular sweet potatoes they’ll still taste great but will be orange-y instead of purple
2 large eggs (or 3 small ones)
1/4 cup milk of choice (I used coconut)
2 cups rolled oats
1/4 cup melted coconut oil (or melted butter)
1/4 cup honey or maple syrup
1tsp vanilla & a pinch of salt
1 tsp baking powder (NOT baking soda- will turn them blue!)
1 tsp lemon juice or vinegar (helps keep that purple color)
18084222794702170.method:
To make the mashed sweet potato: Wash 1 small purple sweet potato, poke a few holes in it with a fork, then microwave for 5mins - flipping it around half way through, let it cool (⚠️it’s going to be steaming hot!) then open it up scooping out that beautiful purple flesh with a spoon and measuring it into 1 cup - if you have extras store it in the fridge for another recipe or I just love to eat it as it is
In a blender dump in all your ingredients and blend until very smooth
Pour batter into cupcake liners filling them almost to the top
Bake in preheated 350 F oven for 25mins

18095094647430537.ingredients:
Sooji (semolina)
Sweet potato
Curd/yogurt
Any veggies (steamed), I used broccoli, zucchini, sweet potato
Spinach
18095094647430537.method:
Mix curd snd sooji (semolina) with some water and keep in aside for 20 minutes
Add veggies, spinach
Mash everything together to make a thick batter
Cook using some ghee

18099550103638665.ingredients:
2 ripe bananas
3 big tablespoons Rozier Ghee
A little sugar
Date powder
Sprouted ragi flour, as needed for binding
A drop of vanilla essence
Desiccated coconut
Chocolate chips for topping
18099550103638665.method:
Mash the bananas in a bowl.
Add Rozier Ghee, a little sugar, date powder, sprouted ragi flour, vanilla essence, and desiccated coconut.
Mix everything well and add enough ragi flour to bring the mixture together into a workable dough.
Shape into small balls and flatten them.
Place on a greased baking tray and add a few chocolate chips on top.
Bake at 180°C for approximately 14 minutes per tray. Check that they’re cooked through, and adjust the time according to your oven and cookie size.

18105213443220818.ingredients:
chickpea pasta
around 8 small sheets of roasted seaweed
5 medium shrimp
¼ tsp minced garlic
½ tsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tsp olive oil
grated parmesan
warm water
2–4 tbsp reserved pasta water
18105213443220818.method:
Cook pasta until soft. Reserve pasta water before draining.
Heat olive oil in a pan over low heat. Add garlic, shrimp, and low-sodium soy sauce.
Tear seaweed into small pieces and soak in 2 tbsp warm water for 2–3 minutes.
Add soaked seaweed and soaking water, garlic and olive oil, soy sauce, and 2 tbsp pasta water to blender and blend until smooth.
Toss cooked pasta in shrimp and seaweed sauce.
Add dash of whole milk for extra creaminess.

18110056511626185.ingredients:
Salmon cubes
Garlic
Lime
Ginger
Olive oil
A dash of maple syrup
Soy sauce
Steamed white rice
Black sesame seeds
Green onions
Fresh cucumber
Strawberries
18110056511626185.method: Baked salmon cubes tossed in a simple marinade of garlic, lime, ginger, olive oil, a dash of maple syrup & soy sauce. Served with steamed white rice topped with black sesame seeds and green onions, fresh cucumber & strawberries!

18110136899193083.ingredients:
½ cup mild Dahi + 1 cup Water
1 tbsp Sprouted Ragi flour + 1 tbsp Besan
¼ tsp Haldi + pinch of Hing
Tadka: 1 tsp Ghee, ¼ tsp Jeera, ¼ tsp Rai, chopped Curry leaves
¼ cup Rice (soaked 15 mins)
2 tbsp finely grated Carrot + 2 tbsp Green Peas (lightly mashed) or any veggies of your choice.
¾ cup Water
1 tsp Desi Ghee
Mild Whole Spices: ¼ tsp Rai/jeera, 1 Green Cardamom (Elaichi), 1 small Bay Leaf (Tej Patta)
Pinch of Haldi
18110136899193083.method:
Whisk: Mix dahi, ragi, besan, haldi, and water until lump-free.
Simmer: Heat ghee, crackle jeera, rai, hing, and curry leaves. Lower flame, pour in the mix, and simmer for 8–10 mins until thick.
For Pulao -
Temper: Heat ghee in a small cooker, add jeera, elaichi, and bay leaf.
Sauté: Toss in grated carrot and mashed peas for 1 min. Add soaked rice, haldi, and water.
Cook: Pressure cook for 3–4 whistles until soft and mushy. Remove whole spices before serving. Serve warm!

18113292818602174.ingredients:
THE CAULIFLOWER
1 small cauliflower, cut into florets
1 tbsp olive oil
A pinch of cumin, turmeric & mild paprika
2–3 tbsp water
THE TZATZIKI-STYLE DIP
3 tbsp thick plain yogurt
2 tbsp finely grated cucumber (squeeze out excess water)
A little finely chopped coriander or dill
A tiny pinch of roasted cumin
A few drops of lemon juice
Optional: a tiny bit of finely grated garlic
18113292818602174.method:
Toss cauliflower with olive oil and spices.
Arrange on a baking tray, add a splash of water, cover with foil and bake at 180°C for 30–35 minutes until super soft.
Uncover for 5–8 minutes for those lovely golden edges.
Mix the tzatziki ingredients until creamy.
Dip, dunk and enjoy!

18130734472689571.ingredients:
2 cups macaroni
2 cups mixed peas, corn and carrot
⅓ cup plain flour
3 cups milk
1 tsp oregano
1 1/2 cup grated cheese
½ cup grated Parmesan
Salt and pepper, to taste (optional)
18130734472689571.method:
Cook the macaroni according to packet instructions.
While that is cooking add veg to pot.
Add flour and stir quickly.
Add milk and oregano and stir continuously till it thickens (5ish mins).
Add 1 cup normal cheese and 1/2 cup Parmesan and macaroni and stir to combine.
Fill muffin trays, top with extra 1/2 cups cheese and cook about 25 mins at 180.

18142943503585399.ingredients:
½ cup fully cooked shelled edamame, thawed
½ mango
½ avocado
1 Tbsp Brain Booster Blend
18142943503585399.method: Blend to your desired texture and that’s it!

18144731440523130.ingredients:
Protein of choice – 1 lbs of shrimp, chicken, beef or 1 block of tofu (cut into thin strips and fried for firmness)
1 bag of Bok Choy or Chinese broccoli (about 8 bundles)
4 servings of udon noodles
1 pack of mushrooms – you can use King Oyster, white button or baby bella mushrooms
1 scallion stalk – chopped
Sauce:
2 tbsp of dark soy sauce
2 tbsp of regular soy sauuce
4 tbsp of oyster sauce
2 tbsp of mirin
1 tbsp of sugar
1 tsp of rice wine vinegar
1 tbsp of minced garlic
18144731440523130.method:
Prep your veggies and make the sauce mixing all the sauce ingredients in a bowl and set it aside.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and pour over your udon noodles in a large bowl. Stir gently until noodles become separated – the udon noodles are precooked so they do not need to be cooked. Once the noodles are all separated, drain and rinse in cold water. Make sure to use the noodles right away or add a drop of oil to keep them separated.
Add 1 tbsp of oil of choice to a pan and heat it over medium heat. Start by cooking your protein and when it is fully cooked, remove from pan.
Add your vegetables and mushrooms and saute until they are almost cooked. (Chinese broccoli takes less time than Bok Choy to cook.) Then add your udon noodles and pour your sauce over. Add your protein. Combine everything together for 2 minutes and turn off heat.
Top with chopped scallions and Sriracha and enjoy!

18189852412409384.ingredients:
Kabocha squash (or butternut squash, sweet potato, or pumpkin; canned pumpkin works too and doesn’t need to be roasted)
Olive oil
Red lentils (or canned lentils)
Water
A chopped shallot
A few fresh sage or basil leaves
Butter (or olive oil)
Cream or milk
Freshly grated Parmesan
Pasta
Pasta water
18189852412409384.method:
Cut your squash into pieces, drizzle with olive oil, and roast at 400°F until fork-tender.
While that’s roasting, cook your red lentils in water until soft (or use canned lentils to save time).
Blend the squash and lentils together until smooth, adding a splash of water if needed.
In a pan, sauté a chopped shallot with a few fresh sage or basil leaves in a little olive oil or butter.
Add your squash and lentil blend, a splash of cream or milk, and some freshly grated Parmesan. Stir everything together until creamy, then toss with your cooked pasta! Add a little pasta water if you need to thin out the sauce.

18201824308382115.ingredients:
Greek Yogurt Naan:
1½ cups all-purpose flour
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tsp baking powder
¼ tsp salt
Garlic Parsley Butter:
¼ cup butter, melted
2 garlic cloves, minced
Fresh curly parsley, finely chopped
Drizzle of olive oil
18201824308382115.method:
In a large bowl, combine flour, baking powder, and salt. Add Greek yogurt and mix until a dough forms.
Transfer to a lightly floured surface and knead for 2–3 minutes until smooth. Add a little extra flour if sticky.
Divide dough into 4–6 equal pieces (or smaller portions for toddler-sized naan!) and roll into thin ovals or circles.
Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat. Cook each naan for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown, slightly puffed, and cooked through.
Combine melted butter, minced garlic, chopped parsley, and a drizzle of olive oil. For a milder garlic flavour, gently warm the garlic in the butter before mixing.
Brush the warm naan with garlic parsley butter and enjoy!

18350955793220400.ingredients:
200g sweet potato, steamed
1 apple, peeled, grated and squeezed to remove excess liquid
180g self-raising flour (or plain flour/white spelt flour mixed with 2 teaspoons baking powder)
50g butter or dairy-free butter, melted
18350955793220400.method:
Preheat the oven to 180°C/350°F.
Place the steamed sweet potato in a large bowl and mash with a fork.
Add the grated apple, melted butter and flour, then mix everything together with your hands to form a dough.
Roll out the dough on a floured surface or baking paper until about ½ cm thick, then cut out shapes using a cookie cutter.
Place on a lined baking tray and bake for around 10 minutes. Keep an eye on them to make sure they don’t overcook, as all ovens are different.
Leave to cool before serving.

18431132914183059.ingredients:
3 cups almond flour
1 cup tahini (make sure it’s made of 100% sesame)
1/2 cup pure maple syrup or raw honey
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
Sprinkle of sea salt
Optional: sesame seeds for topping
18431132914183059.method:
Preheat oven to 350 F
Mix all ingredients in a bowl until it looks like cookie dough (if it feels too crumbly then add some more tahini)
Shape into balls and place on parchment-lined baking sheet
Press them down with your fingers or a fork and top with sesame seeds if using
Bake for 7 minutes
Yes ONLY 7 minutes! I know they will look raw at first but just leave them to cool down on the baking sheet, don’t move them anywhere until they’re completely cool, they will start to harden slightly but will still be super chewy!

18432698818121894.ingredients:
1 pack chicken drumsticks (5 drumsticks)
1 bunch scallions
½ onion
1 handful garlic cloves
3 cups water
Any vegetables you have at home
Soaked rice
18432698818121894.method:
Prep the vegetables.
Add the chicken, prepared vegetables, and 3 cups of water to a pot. Cook for 15 minutes.
Remove the chicken and shred it into small pieces.
Blend any vegetables you have at home until smooth.
Add the chicken broth, soaked rice, blended vegetables, and shredded chicken to a pot. Cook until the porridge reaches your desired consistency.
Freeze the porridge in an ice cube tray and use whenever needed.

18132897259741249.ingredients:
3 onions
1 cup Greek yogurt
1/4 cup mayo
1 tbsp white vinegar
Salt, pepper & pinch of cayenne (optional)
Chives or green onion for serving
18132897259741249.method:
Dice onions, consider using a chopper!
In a large skillet add olive oil
Add onions and sauté on medium-low heat for 45 minutes, stirring often
Once onions are caramelized, remove and place on a cutting board to cool
Finely dice chives
In a medium bowl, combine onions with yogurt, mayo, chives, vinegar and spices
Serve with chips, baguette, crackers or vegetables

18083594678706070.ingredients:
Paneer
Curd / dahi
Mustard seeds
Cumin seeds
Curry leaves
Garlic
Ghee or oil
Semolina / sooji
Boiled peas
Carrots
Raisins
Water
Turmeric powder
Cumin powder
Coriander powder
18083594678706070.method:
Grind paneer and curd/dahi together.
Temper mustard seeds, cumin seeds, curry leaves, and garlic in ghee/oil.
Roast semolina/sooji for 3-4 minutes.
Add boiled peas, carrots, and raisins; pour in water.
Season with turmeric powder, cumin powder, and coriander powder; cook until thick and fluffy.
Stir in the ground paneer-curd mixture and cook on low heat for 3-4 minutes.

18114203309127471.ingredients:
1 tsp ghee or unsalted butter
Cumin
Mustard seeds
Turmeric (optional)
Finely grated carrot
Crumbled tofu
2 tablespoons semolina (Cream of Wheat)
Water
Banana
Pinch of shredded cheese
Homemade nut powder
18114203309127471.method:
Heat ghee or unsalted butter in a pan with cumin, mustard seeds, and optional turmeric.
Add finely grated carrot and crumbled tofu and stir.
Add semolina and roast until golden brown and aromatic.
Add water and cook until very soft.
Serve with mashed banana topped with a pinch of shredded cheese and homemade nut powder.

17974594416172274.ingredients:
Yellow moong dal
Ginger
Salt
Water
Tomato
Garlic
Curd
Onions
Spices
Black seeds (kalonji)
17974594416172274.method:
Soak yellow moong dal, then blend it with ginger, salt and water into a smooth batter.
Separately blend tomato, garlic and curd for the sauce.
Sauté chopped onions and tomatoes in a pan, add spices, then pour in the tomato-curd mixture and cook down.
Place ladles of the dal batter on top of the simmering sauce, sprinkle with black seeds (kalonji), cover and steam until set, then lift out.

17955913308251782.ingredients:
Flour
Tapioca starch
Water
Salt
Spring onions, chopped
Egg
Oil
Cheese (optional)
Dark soy sauce
Sesame oil
Chili oil
17955913308251782.method:
Mix flour and tapioca starch with water to create a thin batter, season with salt, and add chopped spring onions. Whisk a separate egg.
Heat oil in a non-stick pan, pour a ladle of batter to form a thin crepe, and cook for about two minutes. Remove the crepe.
Cook the egg in the same pan, place the crepe back on top, and flip.
Add optional cheese and roll up tightly.
Slice the roll into segments, plate, and top with dark soy sauce, sesame oil, and chili oil.

17968972404226976.ingredients:
Oil
Diced onions
Ground beef
Water
Broccoli, finely chopped
Pinch of salt
Cooked white rice
17968972404226976.method:
Pour oil into a pan, add diced onions and sauté.
Add raw ground beef and break it up until browned.
Pour in water, add finely chopped broccoli and mix.
Add more water and sprinkle a pinch of salt.
Add cooked white rice and stir together with the meat and vegetables until fully combined.

17933255253413126.ingredients:
8-10 small broccoli florets
4-6 almonds
Half an onion
1 clove garlic
1 tablespoon cream cheese
Water
Olive oil
Oregano
Black pepper
1/4 cup cooked pasta
17933255253413126.method:
Boil the broccoli florets with almonds, onion, and garlic for 5-7 minutes until tender.
Blend the boiled ingredients with cream cheese and a little water into a smooth paste.
Heat the paste in a pan with olive oil, season with oregano and black pepper, and cook on low flame for 5 minutes until creamy.
Add cooked pasta and mix in.

17889602523616181.ingredients:
Potato, mashed
Makhana (fox nut) flour
Cilantro, chopped
Homemade spice powder
Sweet potato, diced and cooked
Salt
Cumin seeds
Water
Oil
17889602523616181.method:
Mix mashed potato, makhana flour, chopped cilantro, homemade spice powder, diced cooked sweet potato, salt, cumin seeds, and water by hand into a cohesive dough.
Portion and flatten into small round tikkis.
Fry in a lightly oiled non-stick pan until crisp and browned on both sides.

18425160343121091.ingredients:
2-3 broccoli florets
Oats
Suji (semolina)
Black pepper
Hing (asafoetida)
Avocado oil
Water
Ghee
Sesame seeds, toasted
18425160343121091.method:
Cut broccoli florets, microwave until soft, and finely grate them.
Mix with oats, suji, black pepper, hing, a spoon of avocado oil, and water to form a dough.
Shape the mixture into mini kebab sticks.
Pan-fry in ghee until golden brown on both sides.
Finish with toasted sesame seeds.

18227524783332101.ingredients:
Cooked black-eyed peas
White rice
Fresh spinach, chopped
Seasonings
18227524783332101.method:
Mash cooked black-eyed peas in a bowl with a fork.
Mix with white rice, chopped fresh spinach, and seasonings.
Shape by hand into six small oval patties.
Pan-fry until golden brown on both sides.

18122260660700202.ingredients:
Lauki (bottle gourd), chopped
Soya beans, soaked and squeezed
Moong dal, soaked
Garlic cloves
Bay leaf
Black pepper
Clove
Water
Haldi (turmeric)
Jeera powder (cumin)
Roasted besan (gram flour)
Coriander leaves, chopped
Ghee
18122260660700202.method:
Add chopped lauki to a pot with soaked and squeezed soya beans, soaked moong dal, garlic cloves, bay leaf, and black pepper with clove. Pressure cook with a little water.
Remove the whole spices from the mashed mixture.
Season with haldi, jeera powder, and roasted besan. Mix in chopped coriander leaves.
Shape into small patties using oiled hands.
Shallow fry in ghee until golden.

18137736112579555.ingredients:
1 cup frozen raspberries
1 tsp soaked chia seeds
5-6 pitted dates
1 tsp coconut oil
1 1/3 cups oats
Shredded coconut
18137736112579555.method:
Add frozen raspberries, soaked chia seeds, pitted dates, coconut oil, and oats to a blender and blend into a bright pink paste.
Roll the mixture into balls and dip in shredded coconut.

18101486054256293.ingredients:
Amaranth
Water
Beyond The Sugar super sweetener (monkfruit and allulose)
Nuts
Saffron
Cardamom
18101486054256293.method:
Soak amaranth for 2-3 hours, then boil it.
Sift into a pan, add water, and cook, stirring, until it thickens into a paste.
Add the sweetener along with nuts, saffron, and cardamom, and stir again.
Roll the warm mixture by hand into smooth balls.

18220610953351027.method:
Pour frozen peas into a bowl, crack a whole egg over them, and add shredded cheese.
Mix the ingredients together.
Spoon into a hot non-stick frying pan to form small round fritters.
Cook until golden brown on both sides.

17887025334671537.ingredients:
1 banana
A handful of spinach
1 tbsp greek yogurt
2 tbsp rolled oats
1 egg
2-3 tbsp flour
1 tsp baking powder
17887025334671537.method:
Add all ingredients except flour and baking powder in the blender and blend.
Add flour and baking powder and mix until you get thick consistency like in the video
Grease the pan with oil and spoon mixture into pancake shapes
Cook both sides until cooked through
Serve with vitamin c for ultimate iron absorption

17917448448275418.ingredients:
½ cup quinoa
½ cup red lentils
1 tbsp semolina
1 tbsp yogurt
Tomato, onion, carrot, zucchini (for topping)
17917448448275418.method:
Soak ½ cup quinoa + ½ cup red lentils 3–4 hrs.
Blend, add 1 tbsp semolina + 1 tbsp yogurt, rest 15 min.
Cook on pan both sides till soft.
Can be topped with tomato, onion, carrot, zucchini.
Salt can be added for babies above 1year old.

17988192201010565.ingredients:
Paneer
Potato
Carrot
Broccoli
Roasted Oats powder
17988192201010565.method:
Steam or boil potato, carrot and broccoli until soft.
Mash the vegetables and add crumbled paneer.
Mix in oats powder until a dough-like consistency forms.
Shape into baby-friendly fingers.
Pan-fry in ghee (if already introduced), or bake/air-fry until lightly golden.

18021570071698463.ingredients:
2 apples
3 eggs
170g oats
4 tbsp smooth 100% peanut butter
100ml milk
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tsp baking powder

18069468530555856.ingredients:
2 cauliflower florets/pieces
¼–½ red bell pepper
1 small sweet potato, peeled and cubed
1 small carrot, peeled and chopped
Pasta of choice
¼ cup heavy cream (or any other milk)
⅓–½ cup shredded cheese, or to taste
Optional: tiny pinch of garlic powder or onion powder
18069468530555856.method: Steam all veggies until very tender. Blend veggies with a little water until smooth. Add veggie purée and heavy cream to a saucepan over low heat. Stir in cheese until melted and creamy. Add cooked pasta and mix together.

18073651076689950.ingredients:
2 cups of flour
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
1 1/4 cup of ripe avocado
4 tablespoons of melted butter
1/2 cup grated cheese (I use raw mild cheddar) + salt to taste
18073651076689950.method:
Bake at 375 for 15 minutes
Store in air tight container for 4-5 days.

18073783142713286.ingredients:
About 10-15 pitted dates (mine are deglet noor dates. If you have medjool which are bigger, start with about 5 and add more if you think you need to thicken up the dough more) - soaked in warm water for 15-20 min
1 cup of chickpeas (drained & rinsed)
1 1/2 cup of oatmeal
1 ripe banana
1/4 cup of creamy peanut butter
1/4 cup of melted coconut oil
2 tbsp hemp hearts
1 tsp baking soda
1 tsp cinnamon powder
pinch of salt
18073783142713286.method:
Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Soak the dates in warm water for 15-20 min to soften them.
In a blender, bring all the ingredients together and blend until smooth. You might need to add little bit of water if it's too thick and won't blend easily.
Using spoon and wet hands, roll them into balls and press them into discs on parchment paper laid on cookie sheet.
Using back of a chopstick, create small hole in the middle of each pressed discs. You will need to dip the chopstick end in water so that it won't stick.
Bake for 20-30 min, or until bottom of these soft bakes are browned.
To store: place them in an air tight container and keep them in refrigerator for about a week.

18086477879439152.ingredients:
Chicken Katsu:
Chicken thighs
Buttermilk covering chicken
Paprika
Garlic
Onion powder
Egg
Flour
Panko

Apple pie:
2 apples
Honey
1 tsp of cornflour
1 tsp water
Puff pastry
Egg wash

Spinach & ricotta:
A bag of fresh baby spinach
1 tub of ricotta
Tasty cheese
18086477879439152.method:
Chicken Katsu:
Pound chicken thighs till 1cm thick, add buttermilk covering chicken, paprika, garlic, onion powder.
Leave chicken to marinade overnight or at least 4 hours
Coat egg>flour>panko
Wrap in baking paper and freeze
Cook from frozen in airfryer at 180°C for 8mins on each side ( timing might vary, cook till golden brown)

Apple pie:
Dice 2 apples, add honey , cook in rice cooker for 15mins till soften
Make cornstarch slurry, mix 1 tsp of cornflour to 1 tsp water
Pour it into rice cooker after 15mins and let it thicken the sauce for a few more mins
Cool and place on thawed puff pastry
Brush with egg wash and airfry at 180°C for 10mins till golden brown

Spinach & ricotta:
A bag of fresh baby spinach, blanched
1 tub of ricotta
Mix baby ricotta and blanched baby spinach, add tasty cheese for extra flavour and cheesiness

18104745721837219.ingredients:
250g young zucchini (grated and squeezed)
40g melted butter
1 egg
1 tbsp sour cream
100g semi-hard cheese (grated)
A small bunch of parsley (finely chopped)
1 tsp baking powder
Salt & garlic to taste
120g all-purpose flour
Oil (for greasing)
18104745721837219.method:
Grate the zucchini, add a pinch of salt, and let it sit for a few minutes. Squeeze out all the excess liquid thoroughly.
Mix in all the remaining ingredients until combined.
Bake in a waffle maker until golden brown (or fry them like pancakes in a skillet!).

18107160308276418.ingredients:
2 cups of flour
1/2 teaspoon baking powder
1 1/4 cup of ripe avocado
4 tablespoons of melted butter
(Optional) 1/2 cup grated cheese (I use raw mild cheddar)
18107160308276418.method:
Bake at 375 for 15 minutes or until brown- necessary for crispy crackers.
Store in air tight container for 4-5 days.

18111848666471375.ingredients:
2 overripe bananas
1/4 cup raspberries
1/2 cup flour
1/4 tsp cinnamon

18112071094804146.ingredients:
2 tbsp sprouted ragi flour
1 medium sweet potato, steamed/boiled & mashed
1 small carrot, steamed/boiled & mashed
¼ cup grated paneer
1 tbsp grated cheddar cheese
Little coriander, finely chopped
A pinch of black pepper
Salt, as needed
18112071094804146.method:
Steam or boil the sweet potato and carrot until soft. Mash well.
Add ragi, paneer, cheese, coriander, pepper and salt.
Mix everything into a soft dough.
Shape into small finger-sized sticks.
Cook on a lightly greased pan on low-medium heat until golden and cooked through. You can also bake/air-fry if preferred.
Cool slightly and serve.

18130994626659654.ingredients:
½ apple
2 almonds
2 cashews
1 fig
1½ tsp suji
Water / milk as age-appropriate
Ghee
18130994626659654.method:
Soak the figs, almonds and cashews in hot water for 30 minutes. Roast suji in ghee on low flame, add water/milk and cook. Blend the apple, soaked nuts and figs into a smooth paste, add it to the suji and cook until soft and well combined.
For babies below 1 year: use water as appropriate rather than cow’s milk as a drink.

18140604148604708.ingredients:
1 large banana
3 tbsp coconut yogurt
1 tbsp peanut butter or seed butter
1 tbsp chia seeds — optional
18140604148604708.method:
Slice the banana and gently flatten each piece with the bottom of a glass. Add a little yogurt and peanut butter on top, then sprinkle with chia seeds. Freeze for one hour and allow them to soften for a few minutes before serving.
Only use peanut butter if your baby has already been safely introduced to peanuts and hasn’t shown any signs of an allergic reaction.

18158261830458221.ingredients:
Filling:
1 lb. Ground Chicken (96% lean, not fat free)
8 oz. Peeled and Deveined Shrimp, diced small
1/2 Cup Red Cabbage, finely chopped
1/2 Cup Carrot, finely chopped
3 Scallions, sliced
2 Tbsp Finely Chopped Fresh Ginger
2 Garlic Cloves, finely chopped
3 Tbsp Finely Chopped Fresh Cilantro
2 Tbsp Soy Sauce
2 Tbsp Sesame Oil
1+1/2 tsp Kosher Salt
1/2 tsp Pepper
1 Egg

Sauce:
1/4 Cup Warm Water
1 Tbsp Fish Sauce
1 Tbsp Sugar
1 Tbsp Fresh Lime Juice
1 Tbsp Finely Chopped Carrot
1 Tbsp Finely Chopped Fresh Cilantro

Dumplings:
16-18 Sheets Rice Paper
2 Tbsp Neutral Oil, plus more as needed
18158261830458221.method:
In a large bowl, add all the ingredients for the dumpling filling and mix.
In a small bowl, add all the ingredients for the sauce. Mix until the sugar dissolves and set aside.
Fill a pie dish (or large bowl) with warm water and line a cutting board with damp paper towels. Working one sheet at a time, soak the rice paper in the water for 10 to 15 seconds (it will continue to soften as you work), then place it on the paper towel-lined cutting board. Add about 3 Tbsp of filling to the bottom third of the rice paper and spread it into a rectangle, leaving room along the sides and bottom edge. Fold the bottom edge up over the filling and roll once more so the filling is fully enclosed. Fold in the sides, then continue rolling until sealed. Repeat with the remaining rice paper and filling.
In a large nonstick skillet, heat 2 Tbsp oil over medium heat. Working in batches, add the rolls to the skillet, rubbing the bottoms in the oil and leaving space between each. Cook until golden brown on the first side, 5 to 7 mins. Flip and cook on the second side until golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 165°F, 2 to 4 mins more. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining rolls, adding more oil as needed. The rolls may cook faster as the skillet heats up, so check the bottoms frequently to monitor their progress.
Serve with sauce spooned on top and enjoy!

18275803528295255.ingredients:
Veggie Sticks:
1 zucchini
Pumpkin
1 potato
1 egg
About 5 tbsp flour (buckwheat flour was used; add more if needed)

Banana Pancakes:
1 banana
2 eggs
Oats, added gradually until you reach the desired texture
Cinnamon, optional

Carrot & Pumpkin Purée:
Roasted carrot
Roasted pumpkin
No-added-salt bone broth

Prune Purée:
Prunes
Boiling water
18275803528295255.method:
Veggie Sticks:
Cook and mash the veggies, mix with the egg and flour, then shape into sticks and cook until golden and fully set.

Banana Pancakes:
Mash, mix, and cook small pancakes over low-medium heat until fully cooked on both sides.

Carrot & Pumpkin Purée:
Blend until smooth, adjusting the texture for your baby.

Prune Purée:
Soak prunes in boiling water, then blend until smooth.

18334047043258017.ingredients:
1 cup grated apple (about 2 medium apples)
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
1/2 cup milk (whatever you drink)
1 cup oats
4 Tbls butter, melted
1/2 cup coconut sugar (brown or white sugar will work)
2 eggs
1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1 1/2 cups AP flour
1 1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp nutmeg
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
18334047043258017.method:
Preheat oven to 375 degrees
In a medium bowl, mix together apples, yogurt, milk and oats.
In a small bowl, whisk eggs, butter, sugar and vanilla together. Add to your apple, oat mixture.
Fold in the rest of your dry ingredients- flour,baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Mix until fully incorporated.
Spoon into your muffin pans and bake 17-19 minutes for regular muffins, 11-13 minutes for mini muffins, until a toothpick comes out clean.

18440482867132259.ingredients:
2 eggs
1 cup of water
1 tbsp soy sauce (or to taste)
18440482867132259.method:
Beat 2 eggs in a bowl, stir in 1 cup of water, and strain the mixture through a fine sieve into a heatproof bowl.
Place the bowl on a steamer basket over 1 inch of boiling water, cover, and steam on medium heat for 12 minutes.
Slice the set egg and drizzle with 1 tbsp soy sauce (or to taste).

18454330285186825.ingredients:
Sooji (semolina)
Bouled potato
Curd/yogurt
Any veggies (steamed)
Spinach
18454330285186825.method:
Mix curd snd sooji (semolina) with some water and keep in aside for 20 minutes
Add boiled potato, veggies, spinach
Mash everything together to make a thick batter
Cook using some ghee

18602246185015071.ingredients:
Ground beef
Chopped onions
Mushrooms
Bell peppers
Minced garlic
18602246185015071.method:
Stir-fry ground beef with chopped onions, mushrooms, bell peppers, and a little minced garlic. That’s it!
Tip for making zucchini egg rolls: slice the zucchini as thin as possible so it rolls up easily.

18622324768060294.ingredients:
1 cup (160g) cooked chickpeas
1 1/4 cup (150g) whole wheat flour
2 tbsp softened butter
2 tbsp honey
1 egg
1/4 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp baking powder
Homemade fiber rich jam
18622324768060294.method:
Blend chickpeas, butter, honey, and egg until smooth.
Add flour, cinnamon, and baking powder; mix into a soft dough.
Form dough into small balls, flatten slightly.
Press a small heart in the center with your fingertip.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 20 minutes, golden and soft.
Fill the hearts with homemade fiber rich jam once cooled.
Tip: Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

17870721339630465.ingredients:
Paneer – ½ cup
Boiled soya chunks – 1 cup
Onion – 25 g
Garlic – 2 cloves
Coriander leaves – a handful
Gram flour (besan) – 3 tbsp
Black pepper – a pinch (optional)
Red chilli – for 1 year+ only
Cumin powder – 1 tbsp
Salt – for 1 year+ only
Lemon juice – as required
Desi ghee – for shallow frying
Yoghurt – for serving
17870721339630465.method:
Boil soya chunks well and squeeze out all the water.
Blend paneer, soya chunks, onion, garlic and coriander leaves until completely smooth.
Transfer to a bowl, add besan, cumin powder, black pepper and lemon juice.
Mix well and shape into small patties.
Shallow fry on medium heat for 2–3 minutes total, flipping halfway, until a beautiful golden crust forms.
Serve with yoghurt.
17870721339630465.comment_text:

17881077834492655.ingredients:
Pecorino Zucchini Pancakes:
4 medium zucchini, grated
1 cup grated Pecorino Romano
4 large eggs
1/2 cup all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon onion salt
Pinch of black pepper
Olive oil
Optional toppings: labneh/Greek yogurt, dill, parsley

Lemony Dill Chicken Meatballs:
2 lbs ground chicken
2 large eggs
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
Zest and juice of 1-2 lemons (see note above)
6 cloves garlic, minced or crushed
1/2 cup roughly chopped dill
1/4 cup roughly chopped parsley
1 teaspoon salt (double if not cooking for babies)
Pinch of black pepper
17881077834492655.method:
Pecorino Zucchini Pancakes:
Using a cheesecloth, nutmilk bag, or colander, squeeze as much of the water out of the zucchini as you can. Keep going until you can’t possibly get any more water out. Discard the water.
In a large bowl, add the zucchini, and mix in the Pecorino, eggs, flour, onion salt, and a pinch of black pepper.
Add about 1 tablespoon of olive oil to a non-stick skillet or griddle on medium heat. Once the pan is nice and hot, spoon about 1/4 cup of the zucchini batter per pancake into the pan, and cook for 4-5 minutes on each side until it’s crisp and golden.

Lemony Dill Chicken Meatballs:
Preheat oven to 400°F. In a large bowl, add the ground chicken, eggs, breadcrumbs, lemon juice and zest, garlic, dill, parsley, salt, and black pepper. Mix ingredients together using your hands until just combined, taking care not to over-mix.
Using a cookie scoop, portion out your meatballs and add them to the baking sheet. I scoop a heaping portion with the cookie scoop, and then roll them out with my hands. You should have about 36 meatballs (they will be on the smaller side).
Transfer to the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes or until meatballs are fully cooked and reach an internal temperature of 165°F.

17885099217682669.ingredients:
Mashed potato
Shredded beetroot
Boiled peas
Ragi flour
Cooked quinoa
Ghee
17885099217682669.method:
Place mashed potato in a bowl, then add shredded beetroot, boiled peas, ragi flour, cooked quinoa, and a spoonful of ghee.
Mix everything by hand into a soft dough.
Grease palms with ghee and shape small round tikkis.
Preheat a tawa, add a little ghee, place the tikkis on it, and cook gently on both sides until lightly golden.

17939102370086071.ingredients:
2 cooked potatoes
1 cup of cooked lentils
Chopped onions
Spinach
Oat flour
Seasonings
17939102370086071.method:
Mash two cooked potatoes.
Add one cup of cooked lentils, chopped onions and spinach.
Mix in oat flour and seasonings and mix everything together.
Form small round patties and fry them in a pan until golden brown.

17859740172690210.ingredients:
Mini shepherd's pies:
Potatoes
Seasoned ground meat
Vegetables
Puff pastry

LCM style bars:
Rice bubbles
Coconut
Honey

Oat breakfast cake:
Mashed banana
Egg
Oats
Cinnamon
Raspberries
Cream cheese

Strawberry chia pudding:
Banana
Yogurt

Chia seeds

ABC muffins:
Grated carrot
Banana
Egg
Oats
Flour
17859740172690210.method:
Mini shepherd's pies: peel and mash potatoes; fill puff pastry cups with seasoned ground meat and vegetables and bake.
LCM style bars: mix rice bubbles, coconut, and honey; press into a mold.
Oat breakfast cake: combine mashed banana, egg, oats, cinnamon, raspberries, and cream cheese dollops; bake.
Strawberry chia pudding: blend banana, yogurt, strawberries, and chia seeds; portion into jars.
ABC muffins: mix grated carrot, banana, egg, oats, and flour for muffins; dust with powdered sugar.

18086719814147742.ingredients:
Nut butter
Honey
Puffed rice cereal
18086719814147742.method:
Pour nut butter into a bowl, add honey, and stir until smooth.
Add puffed rice cereal and mix thoroughly to coat the cereal.
Transfer the mixture onto parchment paper in a baking pan and press flat into an even slab.
After it sets, cut the slab into rectangular bars.

18107616101586238.ingredients:
Banana Oat Muffin:
1 banana
2 large eggs
1/2 cup oat flour
Cinnamon powder
Oat milk
Olive oil (for greasing)

Lentils & Carrots Okoy:
1/2 cup soaked lentils
Grated carrots
1 large egg
Chopped green onions
Garlic powder
Oat flour
Oil
18107616101586238.method:
Banana Oat Muffin:
Mash one banana in a bowl, add two large eggs and mix.
Add 1/2 cup oat flour, cinnamon powder, and oat milk; mix until combined.
Grease a muffin mold with olive oil, fill with batter, and bake at 350 degrees for 18-20 minutes.

Lentils & Carrots Okoy:
Grind 1/2 cup soaked lentils in a processor.
Place grated carrots in a bowl, add the ground lentils, one large egg, chopped green onions, and garlic powder; mix.
Add oat flour as an extender and mix again.
Pan-fry at medium heat in oil until golden, then drain on paper towel.

18337401271266777.ingredients:
Pumpkin overnight oats:
Rolled oats
Pumpkin puree
Peanut butter
Chia seeds
Hemp seeds
Soy beverage

Roasted squash zig zags:
Butternut squash, crinkle-cut
Cinnamon

Pumpkin pancakes:
Pumpkin puree
1 egg
Flour
Cinnamon

Butternut squash mac and cheese:
Cubed squash
Soy milk
Shredded cheese
Elbow macaroni
18337401271266777.method:
Pumpkin overnight oats: spoon rolled oats into jars, add pumpkin puree, peanut butter, chia seeds, and hemp seeds, pour in soy beverage, stir, and seal the jars.
Roasted squash zig zags: arrange crinkle-cut butternut squash pieces on a parchment-lined baking sheet and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Pumpkin pancakes: mix pumpkin puree with an egg, flour, and cinnamon; cook small pancakes on a skillet, slice into strips, and place in a container.
Butternut squash mac and cheese: steam cubed squash, blend it, heat soy milk in a saucepan, melt shredded cheese into it, stir in the squash puree, add cooked elbow macaroni, mix thoroughly, and portion into a freezer tray.

17911188891444125.ingredients:
1 peeled banana
Half an avocado
Ragi (finger millet) powder
Whole wheat flour
Cinnamon powder
Water
Oil (for the pan)
17911188891444125.method:
Add one peeled banana and half an avocado to a bowl and mash together with a fork.
Add several tablespoons of ragi powder, a few tablespoons of whole wheat flour, a sprinkle of cinnamon powder, and some water; whisk into a thick pancake batter.
Spoon small portions of batter into an oiled non-stick pan, cook until set, flip, and cover to finish.

18102220097611789.ingredients:
Chopped potatoes
Broccoli florets
Shredded cheese
1 egg
Flour
18102220097611789.method:
Add chopped potatoes and broccoli florets to a baby food maker, steam for 20 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Pour the puree into a bowl, add shredded cheese, an egg, and flour; whisk into a thick batter.
Spoon small rounds of batter into a hot non-stick frying pan and cook until golden brown on both sides.

18118263655641115.ingredients:
Finely chopped broccoli
Shredded cheese
1 egg
18118263655641115.method:
Place finely chopped broccoli in a bowl, add shredded cheese and a cracked egg, and mix together.
Spoon the mixture onto a hot waffle iron and cook until golden.

18317044282280327.ingredients:
Half an avocado
1 egg
2 tablespoons of flour
Oil (for the pan)
18317044282280327.method:
Scoop half an avocado into a bowl and mash with a fork.
Add one egg and two tablespoons of flour and mix into the avocado.
Spoon the batter onto a lightly oiled hot pan to form small rounds; cook and flip with a spatula until set.

18105019913293010.ingredients:
Chicken liver
Ghee
Jeera / mustard
Crushed garlic
Curry leaves
Turmeric
Grated carrot
A pinch of salt
Pepper powder
Water
Coriander leaves
Cooked rice
18105019913293010.method:
Wash raw chicken liver, then sauté in ghee with jeera/mustard, crushed garlic, curry leaves, turmeric, grated carrot, a pinch of salt, and pepper powder.
Add water, cook the liver down, mix in coriander leaves, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cooked rice and mash everything to a soft, baby-friendly texture.

18087716198394391.ingredients:
Apple
Sweet potato
Carrots
Red lentils
Water
Shredded cheese
Oat flour
18087716198394391.method:
Slice an apple, peel and cube a sweet potato, and chop carrots.
Combine with red lentils in a pot, add water, and bring to a boil.
Mash the cooked mixture into a thick purée.
For BLW bites, mix shredded cheese and oat flour into the mash, shape by hand into large round patties, place on parchment paper, and bake in the oven.

18121381210694799.ingredients:
Cottage cheese bagels:
Cottage cheese
Flour
Egg wash
Seeds

Banana almond cookies:
Banana
Almond meal

Sweet potato crackers:
Sweet potato
Shredded cheese
18121381210694799.method:
Cottage cheese bagels: shape dough into bagels, brush with egg wash, top with seeds, and bake until golden.
Banana almond cookies: mash banana in a bowl, add almond meal, scoop onto a tray, press each with a fork, and bake.
Sweet potato crackers: boil chopped sweet potato, mash it, mix in shredded cheese, roll the dough, cut into squares, and bake until crispy.

18055490717379774.method:
Soak raw beef in water to remove blood.
Cook the soaked meat, then place in a food processor with a little meat broth and blend to a smooth paste.
Portion the meat paste into a mold with multiple compartments.
After freezing, transfer the cubes into a freezer bag for storage.

17936452839055163.ingredients:
4 broccoli florets (65 grams)
2 carrots
2 potatoes
¼ cup parmesan & cheddar cheese mix (optional)

17957626401120466.ingredients:
125g carrot, peeled and sliced
125g Butternut squash, peeled and cubed
75g cottage cheese
25g parmesan, grated
50g orzo pasta
17957626401120466.method:
Steam carrot & squash for 8-10 mins until soft
Blend with cottage cheese & parmesan until smooth
Cook orzo according to packet instructions
Stir into the sauce & serve

18107920102944412.ingredients:
Chicken and veggie meatballs
1 pound ground chicken
2/3 cup Italian flavored breadcrumbs
1/2 cup shredded carrots
1/4 cup shredded zucchini
1 egg
Roasted veggie pasta sauce
2 carrots, peeled and roughly chopped
1 sweet potato, peeled and roughly chopped
1 bell pepper, seeds removed and roughly chopped
1 onion, peeled and roughly chopped
4 cloves of garlic
1/2 tsp salt
8oz of cottage cheese (you can swap for plain marinara or ricotta)
1 1/4 cup pasta water (can use broth instead)
Sweet potato banana muffins
2/3 cup sweet potato, cooked/steamed and mashed
1 medium ripe banana
1/4 cup unsweetened applesauce
1/3 cup coconut oil
1 tsp baking powder
1 cup flour
18107920102944412.method:
Chicken and veggie meatballs: Preheat oven to 400. Line a baking sheet with foil and spray with nonstick spray.
Mix ingredients in a bowl and form small sized balls.
Bake for 24 minutes or until golden brown.
Store in fridge for up to 5 days or freeze for up to 6 months.
Roasted veggie pasta sauce: Preheat oven to 425. Place chopped veggies on a lined baking sheet and toss with a light coat of olive oil and salt. Roast until veggies are tender and golden, about 25 minutes.
Transfer your veggies to a blender with the cottage cheese and pasta water and blend until smooth.
Toss with whatever pasta you like, I use the mini shells.
Store up to 5 days in an airtight container in the fridge, freeze the extra for up to one year.
Sweet potato banana muffins: Preheat oven to 350. Line a mini muffin tin with nonstick spray.
In a large mixing bowl, mash banana until smooth, stir in sweet potato, applesauce, and melted coconut oil. Stir in baking powder and flour until it forms a batter.
Fill each muffin tin 3/4 and bake for 15-18 minutes. Put a fork through the center to check if they’re cooked all the way through. Store at room temperature for 2 days or in the fridge in an airtight container for up to 4 days. Freeze for up to 3 months.

18095006384289849.ingredients:
fruits (2 big strawberries or 6 blackberries, 1 mandarin)
30g of rice powder
1 egg

18184190878379373.ingredients:
some olive oil
1 chopped garlic clove
1 chicken leg
salt + whole spices: 2 kali mirch, 1 small piece cinnamon & 1 laung
vegetables — carrot, zucchini, parwal, ghiya, mushroom, beans & spinach
2 tablespoons washed rice
¾ cup water
18184190878379373.method:
Heat some olive oil and add 1 chopped garlic clove
Add 1 chicken leg
Season with salt + whole spices: 2 kali mirch, 1 small piece cinnamon & 1 laung
Add your vegetables — I used carrot, zucchini, parwal, ghiya, mushroom, beans & spinach
(You can also add broccoli or tori if you have them!)
Sauté everything well
Add 2 tablespoons washed rice
Add ¾ cup water
Pressure cook on high flame for 1 whistle, then cook on low flame for 10 mins
You can de-bone or mash the chicken depending on your baby’s preference. Don’t forget to remove the whole spices before serving

18101336468099271.method:
Roast the bones at 375°F for ~25-30 min
Let cool until warm
Scoop out the marrow (don’t waste a thing!)
Chill in the fridge for 20 min
Whip until you get that creamy consistency
Fridge (sealed glass container): 3-4 days
Freezer: up to 6 months
Use the leftover bones to make a super nutritious bone broth. Just simmer them until the water turns milky white.

Spinach for iron
Broccoli for vitamin C
Banana for natural sweetness
17881757667374944.method: Freeze your purees into cubes and mix as needed.

18089908343357445.ingredients:
fresh papaya
Pre-Roasted Poha Powder
breast milk
plain boiled carrot
Pre-Roasted Sattu Maavu
curd
salt-free Khichdi with finely chopped boiled veggies
salt-free steamed veggies and seasonal fruits
watermelon juice
Salt-Free Onion-Tomato Uttapam
salt-free baby Pronthi (Paratha)
Homemade Desi Ghee
18089908343357445.method:
Breakfast: I took fresh papaya from the hotel buffet, mashed it, and mixed it with my travel-essential Pre-Roasted Poha Powder and a little breast milk. (I also grabbed few pcs of papaya from the buffet for her mid-morning snack!).
Lunch (At a restaurant): I asked the restaurant kitchen for a plain boiled carrot. I mashed it, combined it with my Pre-Roasted Sattu Maavu from home, and rolled it into instant, soft cutlets! Served with a side of curd. I even packed a couple of these for her evening snack.
Dinner: Requested a simple, salt-free Khichdi with finely chopped boiled veggies from the hotel.

Lunch: Knowing we’d be out, I requested the hotel to prepare a Salt-Free Onion-Tomato Uttapam which I packed and carried with us. Easy, soft, and mess-free!

17940287118140685.ingredients:
1 banana mashed
2tbsp sprouted ragi
1cup of water
A pinch of cinnamon (optional)
17940287118140685.method:
In a bowl add the ragi and whisk with water.
Add it into a pan with a little ghee. You can either add it now or after it’s cooked.
Mix till thick and cooked - about 4-5 mins.
In a bowl, mash banana and add the ragi mixture.
Mix well and add some cinnamon (if you like)
Make sure it’s cool as it can be very hot for babies and burn.

18100037267300130.ingredients:
Chana sattu powder (roasted gram flour)
Ghee
Water / milk if you’ve introduced cow milk
18100037267300130.method:
Bhuno the sattu with a little bit of ghee.
Add water on low heat, stirring continuously to avoid lumps, until it thickens into a smooth porridge.
Cool well because it can be hot and burn.

17868713889502223.ingredients:
½ cup rava (suji)
2–3 tbsp curd
½ lauki (grated & squeezed)
1 small carrot (grated)
50g paneer (grated)
2–3 tbsp sprouted moong (optional)
1 boiled potato (for binding)
Pinch haldi + jeera powder
Salt (optional for babies)
Ghee for cooking
17868713889502223.method:
Mix lauki + carrot + paneer + moong + potato
Add rava + curd
Keep it thick (not watery)
Rest 5–10 mins (rava will absorb moisture)
Tip: If loose, add little more rava
Heat tawa, grease with ghee
Pour batter and spread small thick circle (like mini uttapam, not thin dosa)
Keep it slightly thick so it acts like bread
When base is half cooked, add your lauki mixture on top
Spread gently
Cover and cook on low flame 5-6 mins
Flip carefully
Cook till both sides golden

17950786554100739.ingredients:
100-150gm walnuts
5-6 deseeded dates
desiccated coconut
melted chocolate (optional)
17950786554100739.method:
Grind them together
Transfer in plate, knead it for 1mins and make elongated roll of it.
Cover them with desiccated coconut, this add a great flavour to it.
With chopstick make an elongate depth on the roll.
This is completely optional, add good quality melted chocolate on it.
Let it set in fridge for 10mins and then cut in bite size.

18079333634037908.ingredients:
½ cup poha
½ cup oats
1 cup makhana
8 almonds
8 cashews
4–5 walnuts
2 tbsp roasted chana
18079333634037908.method:
Dry roast poha, oats, and makhana till crisp.
Lightly roast nuts and chana.
Cool and grind to powder.
Store in an airtight jar.
At room temperature: 1–2 months in an airtight container, if kept in a cool, dry place.
In the refrigerator: up to 4 months.
In the freezer: up to 6 months.
Once cooked or mixed with water/milk, it should be used within 4–6 hours (room temp) or refrigerated for up to 24 hours.

18255760258291009.ingredients:
leftover roasted bones
carrots
celery
water
apple cider vinegar
18255760258291009.method:
Chop the carrots and celery.
Place the leftover roasted bones into a slow cooker.
Add the chopped vegetables, cover everything with water, and add apple cider vinegar.
Cook low and slow for 36 hours.
Strain the broth and pour it into small glass jars for the freezer.

17889132117330652.ingredients:
ghee
cumin
cardamom
curry leaves
garlic
onion
chopped carrot
turmeric
cleaned chicken liver
crushed pepper
washed soaked rice
water
17889132117330652.method:
Heat ghee in a pressure cooker.
Add cumin, cardamom, curry leaves, garlic, onion, chopped carrot, turmeric, cleaned chicken liver, crushed pepper, and washed soaked rice, followed by water.
Cook for six whistles.
Remove the spices and mash the mixture to a soft, baby-friendly texture.

18052416371415768.ingredients:
about 7 fresh raspberries
1 to 2 teaspoons ground flaxseed (milled golden roasted flax)
approximately 1 teaspoon tahini
18052416371415768.method:
Mash the raspberries with a fork.
Add 1 to 2 teaspoons of ground flaxseed to the mashed berries and mix.
Pour approximately one teaspoon of tahini onto the mixture and mix everything together.

18130961218600055.ingredients:
red rice
moong dal
fresh palak (spinach)
cashews
pepper
cumin
coriander powder
turmeric
onion
garlic
18130961218600055.method:
Soak the red rice and moong dal overnight.
Place fresh palak in a blender jar with cashews, pepper, cumin, coriander powder, turmeric, onion, and garlic, and grind.
Pour the green puree into a pressure cooker containing the soaked grains.
Cook for 5-6 whistles, then mash well and serve warm.

17972367951062094.method:
Add the sweet potato, banana, and eggs to a blender and blend until smooth.
Spoon the batter into small silicone cups.
Bake at 190C for 13 minutes.

18055765802551055.ingredients:
5-6 pitted prunes
1-2 tablespoons chia seeds
coconut milk
warm water
18055765802551055.method:
Soak 5-6 pitted prunes, add 1-2 tablespoons of chia seeds, and let sit 10-15 minutes.
Blend with coconut milk and warm water to desired consistency.
Store in a jar. Serve stirred into cooked oats with pear, or warmed gently in hot water as an evening snack.

17985057929927157.ingredients:
cooked egg yolk
breast milk
mashed avocado
17985057929927157.method:
Mash the cooked egg yolk.
Add breast milk and mix with mashed avocado in a glass bowl.

18092930828611584.ingredients:
Veggie Stock:
carrots
celery
onion
radish
zucchini
spring onion
garlic
water
Prune Puree:
dried prunes
hot water
organic coconut milk
Homemade Cereal:
rice
lentils
other grains
almonds
cashews
makhana
18092930828611584.method:
Veggie Stock: Add the chopped vegetables to water, simmer on low flame for 1 hour, then strain. Store in a glass bottle in the fridge for 3–4 days, and freeze leftover broth in silicone molds.
Prune Puree: Soak dried prunes in hot water, then blend with organic coconut milk and pour into jars.
Homemade Cereal: Wash a mix of rice, lentils, and other grains, spread to dry on a cloth, then toast in a pan with almonds, cashews, and makhana. Grind into a fine powder.

18080077100124868.ingredients:
broth
uncooked rice
butter or oil
chopped broccoli
powdered seasoning
shredded cheddar cheese
18080077100124868.method:
Pour broth into a pot, add uncooked rice, and stir.
Pour melted butter or oil over the cooked rice.
Mix in chopped broccoli, followed by powdered seasoning and shredded cheddar cheese.
